description_en: Creates a ServiceTask (heap dump or LiveDebug diagnostic task) for a specified application
description_zh: 为指定应用创建 ServiceTask（堆转储或 LiveDebug 诊断任务）
kebab_example: aliyun cms create-service-task --workspace default-cms-1672753017899339-cn-hangzhou --service-id ggxw4lnjuz@f2fd3a6265a254a052afb --api-version 2024-03-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateServiceTask

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the target instance. This parameter is optional. If not specified, some tasks can match instances by scope (such as instanceIds). This parameter is typically required for heap dump scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例 IP。可选；未指定时部分任务可按实例范围（如 instanceIds）匹配。堆转储场景通常需要指定
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The task configuration. The value is a JSON string with a maximum length of 65536 characters. This parameter is required for LiveDebug task types. Use a flat JSON structure and pass a single command or probe object directly. Do not wrap it in a commands or probes array. Probe example (dynamic log): {"probeType":"LOG","language":"java","target":{"typeName":"com.example.UserService","methodName":"getUser","location":"exit","instanceIds":[""]},"action":{"type":"LOG","template":"userId=${args[0]}","templateSegments":[{"type":"TEXT","value":"userId="},{"type":"EXPRESSION","value":"args[0]"]},"ttl":"1h","captureCount":100}. Command example (OGNL): {"commandType":"EVALUATE_EXPRESSION","language":"java","params":{"expression":"@java.lang.System@getProperty(\"java.home\")"},"instanceIds":[""]}. Note: The Command type must include instanceIds at the top level. For Probe types, instanceIds is placed inside the target object. The action.metricType for METRIC probes can be set to COUNTER, GAUGE, HISTOGRAM, or SUMMARY. The Java Agent supports only COUNTER and GAUGE
parameters.help_zh: 任务配置，JSON 字符串，长度不超过 65536。LiveDebug 类型必填。使用扁平 JSON 结构，直接传单个命令/探针对象，不要用 commands/probes 数组包裹。Probe 示例（动态日志）：{"probeType":"LOG","language":"java","target":{"typeName":"com.example.UserService","methodName":"getUser","location":"exit","instanceIds":[""]},"action":{"type":"LOG","template":"userId=${args[0]}","templateSegments":[{"type":"TEXT","value":"userId="},{"type":"EXPRESSION","value":"args[0]"]},"ttl":"1h","captureCount":100}。Command 示例（OGNL）：{"commandType":"EVALUATE_EXPRESSION","language":"java","params":{"expression":"@java.lang.System@getProperty(\"java.home\")"},"instanceIds":[""]}。注意：Command 类型顶层必须包含 instanceIds；Probe 的 instanceIds 放在 target 内。METRIC 探针 action.metricType 可选 COUNTER/GAUGE/HISTOGRAM/SUMMARY，Java Agent 仅支持 COUNTER、GAUGE
parameters.name: task_config

parameters.help_en: The task type. This parameter is required. Valid values: heapdump (heap dump). LiveDebug Probe: live_debug_log_probe, live_debug_snapshot_probe, live_debug_metric_probe, live_debug_span_probe, live_debug_span_tag_probe. LiveDebug Command: live_debug_inspect_object, live_debug_search_type, live_debug_search_method, live_debug_decompile, live_debug_get_thread_info, live_debug_get_runtime_info, live_debug_get_memory_info, live_debug_evaluate_expression, live_debug_modify_logger_level. LiveDebug Code Replace: live_debug_code_replace
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型，必填。支持：heapdump（堆转储）；LiveDebug Probe：live_debug_log_probe、live_debug_snapshot_probe、live_debug_metric_probe、live_debug_span_probe、live_debug_span_tag_probe；LiveDebug Command：live_debug_inspect_object、live_debug_search_type、live_debug_search_method、live_debug_decompile、live_debug_get_thread_info、live_debug_get_runtime_info、live_debug_get_memory_info、live_debug_evaluate_expression、live_debug_modify_logger_level；LiveDebug 代码热替换：live_debug_code_replace
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_zh: 工作空间名称。例如 default-cms-<uid>-<region>
parameters.name: workspace

schema.description_en: The response returned when the task is created

taskId.description_en: The ID of the created task. Use this ID for subsequent query or deletion operations
taskId.description_zh: 创建成功的任务 ID，后续查询/删除使用该 ID
